edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source ACTUALLY PRACTISED on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period; no hypothetical, theoretical or contingent amount is certified (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799 and 21155 Income Tax Pensioner. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional, not withholding practised, and are NOT certified; the same exclusion applies to every wage type that computes a theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding. Wage types 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country are certified here where the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) classifies the wage type as withholding actually deducted from the employee's income, and are excluded where it classifies the wage type as theoretical, hypothetical, contingent or informative; the withholding-practised attribute of each comes from the WTC. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
